SE_5.notNormalBehaviour: This test must NOT be read as acceptable endpoint behaviour. SE-5 remains a P2 defect blocking external beta.
SE_5.mo1DoesNotDependOnIt: MO-1's closure does not require SE-5 to stay broken: any error-severity condition reaches the same dispatch path.
SE_5.disclosureFromUsingIt: NONE — the resulting alert payload carries the route pattern and the error class name, not the malformed identifier.
